summary: FBRX is a single-asset clinical-stage biotech. Its supply chain for FB-102 is preclinical/manufacturing dependent, with no approved product. The stock's value hinges entirely on phase 2 results, cash runway, and trial execution.

inputs.whyNeeded: Active pharmaceutical ingredient for trial drug
inputs.fragility: High if CMO faces delays or quality issues
High: no revenue; burn rate unknown

chokepoints.why: Single-source or few suppliers for novel biologic; any disruption delays trials
No revenue; $150M must last through 1-2 years of phase 2; dilution risk if timeline slips

customers.why: No approved product; customers are hypothetical vitiligo/alopecia patients

geographic: US-based R&D (Dallas); likely uses global CMO/API sources, but details unknown
substitutes: Topical JAK inhibitors (e.g., ruxolitinib), other pipeline drugs for vitiligo/alopecia

bearCase: FB-102 fails in phase 2 (no efficacy or safety issues), wiping out pipeline value.
Enrollment delays or high dropout rate stretch cash, forcing dilutive offering above $21/share.
Competing vitiligo/alopecia treatments (e.g., Incyte's ruxolitinib) maintain market lead, limiting commercial prospects even if successful.
Regulatory hold or manufacturing issues cause trial suspension.

loadBearing.assumption: FB-102 shows clinically meaningful benefit in phase 2
loadBearing.breaksIf: Efficacy endpoints not met at data readout (expected late 2026 or 2027)

loadBearing.assumption: Current cash position ($150M) funds operations without further dilution
loadBearing.breaksIf: Trial delays or higher-than-expected burn rate exhaust cash before data
Recruitment lags, pushing data readout beyond 2027
FDA clinical hold or rival drug launches reducing market potential

prediction.statement: FBRX will report phase 2 top-line data for FB-102 in vitiligo/alopecia areata in Q1 2027.
prediction.resolutionCriterion: Company announces results or timeline; if not by May 2027, prediction is false.

gaps: Formulation and manufacturing details for FB-102 unknown.
Burn rate and cash runway specifics not disclosed.
Number of trial sites and enrollment progress unclear.
verifyThese: FB-102 phase 2 start date and expected enrollment completion
Cash burn rate and source of $150M offering (dilution details)
diminishingReturns: Stopped after API-manufacturing node because further depth (e.g., raw chemical suppliers) does not materially change FBRX's risk—it is binary on trial outcomes.
